items.title: *The Week in 15 Selections*
items.content:
Hello and welcome back to the newsletter! I have been smote by god (head cold), and so this intro will be a little shorter than some weeks.

Next week, I will send my best purchases of the year, and the week after that it will be your turn! If you’ve bought something you love this year, please respond to this email and tell me so I can share it with all of our friends (everyone who reads this tiny dumb newsletter is a friend to me)

Throughout their post-election breakdown podcast episode released over the weekend, the All-In bros seem to be on the verge of grasping why Americans are so mad and who they’re mad at, but are still trying to find the guy who did this. They appear to finally grasp that Americans are mad at something called “oligarchs” but largely do not seem to know who they are (it’s them). Populist anger at the oligarchs is a “perception” or “narrative” problem.

  1. On friend of the newsletter (me) Sarah-Grace’s recommendation, I spent my sick Saturday watching the Hulu show , which is like what if the Gilded Age was set in the 1980s England and mainly about fucking. I love it!

  2. I really love these textile tarot cards made by Lesley, a textile artist in LA. Here’s her instagram!

If you like this newsletter, please forward it to somone who might like it! Next week, I will be sending my best purchases of the year!
